reason: B is the better, though still weak, proposal because its deposited Al interlayer is a realizable intervention and can be directly tested against a Cr-only baseline; A’s proposed post-deposition oxidation cannot readily create a buried Cr2O3 layer, and such an ultrathin oxide would likely be reduced by oxygen-gettering Zr at high temperature. B nevertheless needs tighter exposure durations and direct evidence that Al–Zr reaction does not consume the barrier or degrade adhesion.
